name: KittyLand (Horror)
desc:
Welcome to Kittyland!
Beta released on 10/27/2024

Kittyland is a terrifying horror game playable with up to 6 Players!

🚨 DONT EXPECT ANY UPDATES FROM THIS GAME BTW.
🚨 Warning: Contains flashing lights and jump scares.

Meet William as you try to infiltrate Kittyland, then survive the Kittytest!
Buy items from the shop to make your life easier and increase your chances of survival.
